name: io.github.happy520ai/unified-ai-system
title: Unified AI System MCP Gateway
description: Self-hosted AI gateway + MCP server: virtual keys, budgets, audit, OpenAPI-to-MCP, zero API keys.

environmentVariables.name: AI_GATEWAY_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of a gateway that is already running. Leave it unset and the server starts its own loopback gateway with a freshly generated token, which is the credential-free default. When set, the target must be https, or plain http only on 127.0.0.1 / ::1, and the server refuses it unless its health report shows the fake-provider runtime.

environmentVariables.name: AI_GATEWAY_MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token presented to the gateway named by AI_GATEWAY_MCP_URL; must be at least 32 characters. Read only when that variable is set - the locally started gateway mints its own token, so the zero-key default needs neither variable.
